newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday August 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday August 5.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Far right opposition party National Alliance said it would ask for a parliamentary vote of no confidence in Transport Minister Claudio Burlando after three railway accidents in the last three days. (all)

* Italy's Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi handed over crates of personal belongings uncovered from a Treasury vault to the Jewish communities that were plundered by Nazi forces during World War II. (all)
* In an effort to cut fiscal evasion, the government is set to approve on Tuesday a decree that will reduce deductions for Italy's value added tax. (all)
* Markets tremble over the dollar's high level (all)
* Italy's Industry Minister Pierluigi Bersani said that prospective shareholders in the lineup for the privatisation of Telecom Italia are AT&T, Mannesman, IFIL and San Paolo. (Corriere della Sera)
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
